# Lint Integration Tests — nine of the ten checkers in one sweep (required_fields
# is pinned by lint_required_fields.txt), plus --json output and exit codes

# ============================================================
# Section 1: The nine checkers this script plants issues for
# ============================================================

exec akb init lint-kb
cd lint-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

# --- Write pages via akb write (tracked in link graph) ---

stdin ../broken-link-note.md
exec akb write broken-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/broken-note.md'

stdin ../empty-note.md
exec akb write empty-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/empty-note.md'

# ADR with an invalid enum value; write validation rejects it, so it is
# copied in directly.
exec mkdir -p kb/decisions
exec cp ../adr-invalid-status.md kb/decisions/invalid-status-adr.md

stdin ../bad-confidence-note.md
exec akb write bad-confidence.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/bad-confidence.md'

stdin ../short-summary-note.md
exec akb write short-summary.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/short-summary.md'

stdin ../stale-note.md
exec akb write stale.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/stale.md'

stdin ../provenance-drift-note.md
exec akb write prov-drift.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/prov-drift.md'

stdin ../cited-note.md
exec akb write cited-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/cited-note.md'

# --- Write pages directly to kb/ (bypassing akb write) ---

# missing_frontmatter: file without YAML delimiters
exec sh -c 'echo "No frontmatter here" > kb/no-frontmatter.md'

# type_exists: page with unknown type (akb write rejects unknown types)
exec cp ../bad-type.md kb/notes/bad-type.md

# note-type page outside kb/notes/
exec mkdir -p kb/random
exec cp ../misplaced.md kb/random/misplaced.md

# --- Run lint once and verify all nine check types appear ---

! exec akb lint

# 1. broken_links
stdout 'broken_links'

# 2. orphans
stdout 'orphans'

# 3. empty_pages
stdout 'empty_pages'

# 4. missing_frontmatter
stdout 'missing_frontmatter'

# 5. index_consistency
stdout 'index_consistency'

# 6. type_orphan
stdout 'type_orphan'

# 7. citations
stdout 'citations'

# 8. provenance
stdout 'provenance'

# 9. cel_lint (stale page)
stdout 'cel_lint'

# Verify summary line
stdout 'issue\(s\) found'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: --json output
# ============================================================

! exec akb lint --json
stdout '"issues"'
stdout '"summary"'
stdout '"by_check"'

-- broken-link-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Broken Link Note
summary: Note with a broken wikilink
tags: linttest
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
This note links to [[nonexistent-page]].

-- adr-invalid-status.md --
---
type: adr
title: Invalid Status ADR
status: invalid
summary: ADR with invalid status enum value
deciders: team
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Decision with bad status.

-- bad-confidence-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Bad Confidence
summary: Note with invalid confidence value
tags: linttest
confidence: super-high
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Content with bad confidence.

-- short-summary-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Short Summary
summary: Hi
tags: linttest
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Content with too-short summary.

-- stale-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Stale Page
summary: A page with an old updated date
tags: linttest
updated: '2020-01-01'
---
Old content that is stale.

-- provenance-drift-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Provenance Drift
summary: Note with provenance drift
tags: linttest
provenance:
  inferred: 0.9
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Some content without provenance markers.
Another line of content.
A third line here.

-- cited-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Cited Note
summary: Note referencing a missing source
tags: linttest
sources: missing-file.csv
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Content citing a non-manifest file.

-- empty-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Empty Note
summary: An empty page with no body
tags: linttest
updated: '2026-09-01'
---

-- bad-type.md --
---
type: nonexistent
title: Unknown Type
summary: Bad type page
tags: linttest
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Content with bad type.

-- misplaced.md --
---
type: note
title: Misplaced
summary: In wrong directory
tags: linttest
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Content in wrong dir.
